plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: C3: no instrument checks each case's category against the requester's rule. The summary counts only values the agreement fixes, and it fixes none for the category. C5: only 'scope of a call' on named read lines can show it, and it is not allowed in a plan. 101 reads at 10 each is far beyond the allowance of 50, so at most a few lines can be checked. C10: a confirmed sending call does not show that a row reached the outbox, because a preview gets the same label and appends nothing. Only 'trace of a call' on named lines can show it, at A3, at 10 per line, so with 100 sends only a sample, or the calls that were not confirmed, fits the allowance. I would have wanted an instrument that checks the whole outbox against the release, one that checks the categories, and one that checks the scope of every read. Also, no instrument reads the live tables after the promotion: the tie to the staged set rests only on the promotion's line in the record (fp_in and fp_out).
